description: This source file defines the ApiTokenHelper class, providing utility methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes in the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating JWT tokens for testing authenticated API requests.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a standard user.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with specified userName and roles.
